name: Ore to Futago to Natsuyasumi
source:
It's summer break, and Yuji has lots of time available. One day, his cousins, the shy Mana and energetic Rina who are twins, arrive at his home. Apparently, their parents are on the verge of divorce, so the twins have to stay with him temporarily until their family situation settles down. 
Their cohabitation begins, and Yuji has to make sure they experience a very enjoyable stay.
translation:
暑假来临，祐二一下子多出了许多空闲时间。一天，一对双胞胎表妹来到他家：姐姐真奈腼腆内向，妹妹里奈则活泼好动。原来她们的父母正濒临离婚，在家里的问题尘埃落定前，姐妹俩不得不暂时寄住在祐二家。

三人的同居生活就此开始。祐二要做的，便是让这对姐妹度过一段无比愉快的时光。
